description: Identifying Efficient Submodel Fidelity Combinations is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "software", published or maintained by Raul Rincon, Rice University (rice.edu). Not all submodels that encompass infrastructure system performance assessment achieve the same level of fidelity. Even if all reach high-fidelity levels, the required information for accurate regional-scale analysis may not be available. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "software" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-32pd-6s63. Keywords: multiscale models,  uncertainty propagation,  model efficiency,  fragility,  network reliability,  infrastructure resilience. Published 2026-01-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
